question: Should Doctor’s in-process candidate configuration be the authoritative install-policy snapshot for missing-plugin repairs and post-core convergence when it differs from the process runtime snapshot?
rationale: The implementation is correct and fail-safer, but it intentionally changes which configuration controls an installation authorization decision, so the permanent security boundary requires owner confirmation.

options.title: Approve candidate authority
options.body: Merge this patch so every install-policy decision in the repair attempt uses the same candidate configuration that selected the repair.

options.title: Retain ambient authority
options.body: Reject or redesign the patch and document why Doctor repairs must continue using the process runtime snapshot despite in-process config mutation.

recommendation.title: Approve candidate authority
recommendation.body: Merge this patch so every install-policy decision in the repair attempt uses the same candidate configuration that selected the repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the operator install-policy contract whose configuration authority is being clarified.
